title: Elux Legend Apple Peach Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend's Apple Peach Nic Salt is a delightful fusion of crisp apples and ripe peaches. This e-liquid delivers a fruity and satisfying vaping experience that combines the refreshing quality of apples with the lusciousness of peaches. The initial inhale presents the crisp and slightly tart flavour of apples, offering a clean and invigorating taste. This is harmoniously complemented by the sweet and juicy notes of ripe peaches, creating a symphony of fruity goodness. Apple Peach is the perfect choice for vapers seeking a flavour that's both crisp and sweet. Our Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids are available in 10mg or 20mg nicotine strength, making them ideal for recent ex-smokers or vapers seeking immediate and satisfying nicotine relief provided by nic salts. Each flavour is carefully crafted using premium ingredients, ensuring a clean and authentic taste that tantalizes your taste buds with each puff. Elux Legend Nic Salts e-liquids provide a smoother and more satisfying hit than traditional freebase nicotine as nicotine salts are absorbed into the bloodstream faster, allowing for a quick and efficient nicotine delivery without any harshness or throat irritation. The Elux Legend Nic Salts are designed for use with pod systems and other low-wattage devices, providing a more concentrated and flavourful vaping experience. They are the perfect choice for vapers seeking a high-quality, smooth, and satisfying nicotine hit coupled with incredible flavours. Try the Elux Legend Nic Salts line today and experience the next level of vaping satisfaction.
